thread:
tariq (AP): Heads up 1: vendor sent a credit memo for -$8,400 but currency on memo is SGD while original INV-512233 was USD. Auto-apply failed (PO missing + currency mismatch). Need routing advice.
approvals-bot: Invoice/credit memo 2026-06-02-1854123456 queued. Match failed: missing PO; currency mismatch.
vendor-southeast: Hi Tariq, apologies. Our AP exported CM in local currency by mistake. The credit applies to INV-512233 (original USD invoice). We can reissue USD CM or confirm exchange rate used. We can also apply netting now if Redwood approves.
jonas (Procurement): @tariq can you confirm if INV-512233 had a PO? I don't see one on file. If no PO, procurement exception required per policy. Also need confirmation of which GL/project to post to.
tariq (AP): No PO on INV-512233, looks like pre-PO procurement (legacy subscription). GL should be 6102-Cloud-SaaS and project tag pro-ml-infra.
sumi (Legal): For cross-currency credits, we usually require vendor attestation plus tax reissue (local VAT docs). If they reissue USD CM, fine; otherwise we need written confirmation of exchange rate and VAT adjustment.
nate (EngOps): Technically it's just a billing correction for infra usage. Don't block the team; if Finance signs off we can apply quickly.
vendor-southeast: We can do either: (A) reissue USD CM referencing PO if you create one, or (B) sign written confirmation: "Vendor confirms CM-SG-77 equals USD 8,400 applied to INV-512233 at exchange rate 0.73" and provide VAT reversal note.	ariq (AP): Reissue would take 5-7 business days. Vendor confirmation + VAT note would let us net immediately but needs exception.
elaine (Finance Dir): Send me the vendor confirmation text and VAT reversal evidence. If Procurement signs exception, I'll approve the manual netting and note the FX rate used. Elaine: I'll also cc tax for audit trail.
jonas (Procurement): I'll create procurement exception EXC-9003: "credit memo without PO + currency mismatch" and route to Elaine. Please attach vendor confirmation and VAT doc.
approvals-bot: Exception EXC-9003 created, awaiting Elaine (Finance Dir) sign-off.
tariq (AP): Vendor confirmation attached: "Vendor-Southeast confirms CM-SG-77 for SGD 11,520 applies to INV-512233. Agreed USD equivalent at 0.73 = USD 8,409.60. VAT reversal attached."
sumi (Legal): Review complete. Acceptance ok pending tax check.
elaine (Finance Dir): Signed EXC-9003. Approve manual netting at USD 8,409.60 to GL 6102-Cloud-SaaS / project pro-ml-infra. AP team, post and reconcile. Procurement, ask vendor to reissue USD CM with PO for records.
vendor-southeast: Thanks Elaine. We'll reissue USD CM with PO reference and forward VAT reversal. Appreciate the quick resolution.
tariq (AP): Applied credit and reconciled INV-512233. Ledger updated, will attach reconciliation export to the EXC-9003 ticket. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
